findings.text: follow-on: _main_checkout duplicates reckon/crew/node.py:1340 repository_identity — the same git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir resolution with the same ".git"-parent fallback and the same return-itself default; cli.py already imports from reckon.crew.node, so it could call the owner instead of re-deriving it. The section cited the hooks installer's worktree refusal but not this owner.

follow-on: every doctor test stubs _claude_plugin_validate to return None, so doctor's invalid-plugin arm (if message: at reckon/cli.py:8183, which sets ok=False) and _claude_plugin_validate itself are never exercised; a regression in the validation path would not be caught by any test the node added.
